name: Vingilot
summary: Eärendil’s star-vessel reborn as a privacy-first, native GTK4 & Libadwaita web browser for Wayland desktops.
description: Vingilot is a fast, distraction-free GNOME web browser engineered with GTK4, Libadwaita, and WebKitGTK 6.0. Named after the sacred ship of Eärendil that bore the Silmaril across the firmament, it features hardware-accelerated Wayland rendering, strict Flatpak sandbox isolation, and built-in ad/tracker warding.

name: Mithrandir
summary: Modern GNU/Linux cleaner, optimizer, and AI-assisted diagnostics utility in GTK4 / Libadwaita.
description: Mithrandir counsels your Linux system maintenance with deep cleaning, cache pruning, automated diagnostics, and system optimization tools in a sleek Adwaita interface.

name: Mithrandir (Rust)
summary: Modern GNU/Linux Cleaner, Optimizer, Telemetry & Diagnostics rewritten in Rust with GTK4 / Libadwaita.
description: High-performance Rust rewrite of the Mithrandir system utility featuring lightning-fast telemetry collection, cache cleaning, smart boost, and system monitoring.

name: Imladris
summary: Native GTK4 & Libadwaita Markdown Editor with GtkSourceView 5, WebKitGTK 6.0, and libcmark.
description: Imladris (Rivendell) is a haven for writers and developers. A native Markdown editor with live preview, syntax highlighting via GtkSourceView 5, libcmark rendering, and integrated terminal via VTE.

name: Debian Cachy Kernel Updater
summary: Automated graphical & CLI forge to fetch, tune, compile, and install CachyOS BORE kernels on Debian.
description: Brings the responsiveness of CachyOS BORE-scheduler and LTO-optimized Linux kernels to Debian systems. Automates fetching upstream kernel sources, applying CachyOS performance patches, building packages, and managing installed kernel versions safely.

name: YouTube Comment Extractor
summary: Extract and analyze YouTube video comments with a modern GTK4 and Libadwaita interface.
description: Graphical tool using yt-dlp to extract, filter, export, and analyze comments from YouTube videos, with support for random winner selection and sentiment export.

name: YouTube Comment Extractor Service
summary: Background web server and system tray service for YouTube Comment Extractor.
description: Background service providing a local web dashboard and system tray indicator to automate and monitor YouTube comment extraction tasks.
